Content-addressed: cacheable forever only when `v` names the current photo. Any other
`v` (a replaced or removed photo) is a 404 that is never cached, so an old URL can never
be served new bytes.

Upload a profile photo as the raw request body (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to

post.description:
Sends a code to the new address. Always 202, whether or not the address is free. Needs the
password, or for an account without one a sign-in within 15 minutes (409 reauth_required).
Moves the account to the new address and signs out every other device.

patch.description:
Versioned edit of the identity profile: `{version, set, reset}` (docs/api-contract.md).
A stale version answers 409 version_conflict with the current profile in `error.current`.

post.description:
Answers are final, in order and graded here. Sending the same response again returns the
same test unchanged (a safe retry); any other response to an answered question, or to a
question after the waiting one, is 409. The message row is locked while the response is
recorded, so two tabs or a double tap record one response.

A question-bank test also records the answer in the student's practice ledger and, while it is
adaptive, adds its next question chosen from that answer, all in the same transaction: a retry
after a lost reply (with the hash it was shown) gets the test as it is now. `learning` says what
this answer did to the streak when it made its India day a learning day (5 answers a day), as the
chat's `done` does; null otherwise.

evening of a day without learning, this is also when the streak reminder is added.

Versioned edit: `{version, set, reset}` (docs/api-contract.md). Emails are sent only while
the server's rollout allows them (NOTIFICATIONS_MODE); reminders also need a time zone.

The link in a reminder or alert email. No sign-in: the signed token names the student and
the kind of email, and nothing else can be changed with it. Using it again changes nothing.
